result.reason: The operative language does not reach either playbook position. It adds the desired Vendor indemnity triggers, but does not expressly require a defense, limit coverage to third-party claims, or include notice, control, and cooperation procedures. It also leaves Client’s indemnity far broader than Customer-provided content and breach of law. The fallback is not met because there are no customary IP exclusions, procure/modify/replace/refund remedies, or 3× annual-fees super-cap. The IP provision is overbroad as drafted ('any allegation'), and the phrase 'any (i) any claim' is duplicative and unprofessional. Unrelated commercial terms are otherwise largely preserved.
